label: Low sodium
blurb: Sodium counts for much more; ingredients still lead.
coverage_note: Sodium is on 79% of products - the best-covered nutrient we have.
name: low_sodium
_note: Diet profile. Only the WEIGHTING changes - every sub-score is a fact about the product and is computed once, then re-combined per profile in the browser (proto_shared.js applyProfile). Score caps (processed meat 50, seed-oil bottles 25, pure sweeteners 40, severity-3 ingredients 50) still apply under every profile: no diet preference can lift bacon above its ceiling. DELIBERATELY ABSENT: keto / low-carb and high-protein. Total carbohydrate is on only 36% of products and protein 41%, so those profiles would rank mostly on missing data - the exact mistake this project has spent its whole life fixing. Add them if coverage improves.
